posts.en:
dsh-project-kanban is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-db29cb46fefe3f391773.html
